title: Beyond Retrieval Failure: Understanding Why LLMs Miss Evidence in Multi-Hop RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.21184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires an agent to retrieve evidence for a sequence of dependent sub-questions. When a wrong answer lacks a required passage, the passage may be inaccessible to the retriever, or the agent may have failed to issue a query that would retrieve it. Standard retrieval evaluations conflate these two causes. We study how much apparent retrieval failure is instead caused by search drift: the search no longer tracks an unanswered sub-question. Holding the retriever, corpus, and generation model fixed, we introduce ExecutionRAG, a training-free requirement register that records open sub-questions and their supporting evidence. The register changes search guidance but not evidence access, so each gold passage it recovers certifies that the passage was reachable by the original retriever. On 1,000 MuSiQue questions, the number of wrong answers with unretrieved required evidence falls from 382 to 234

translated_title: 超越检索失败：理解大语言模型为何在多跳RAG中遗漏证据
translated_abstract: 多跳检索增强生成（RAG）要求智能体为一系列相互依赖的子问题检索证据。当错误答案缺少所需文本段落时，可能是该段落对检索器不可访问，也可能是智能体未能发出能检索到该段落的查询。标准的检索评估将这两种原因混为一谈。我们研究了表面上看似检索失败的情况中有多少实际上是由搜索漂移造成的：即搜索不再跟踪尚未解答的子问题。在保持检索器、语料库和生成模型固定不变的情况下，我们提出了ExecutionRAG，这是一个无需训练的需求登记表，用于记录未解决的子问题及其支持证据。该登记表只改变搜索引导而不改变证据的可访问性，因此它每恢复一个金标段落，即可证明该段落对原始检索器而言是可访问的。在1000个MuSiQue问题上，包含未检索到所需证据的错误答案数量从382个降至234个。
tldr: 该论文发现多跳RAG中表面上的检索失败很大程度上源于“搜索漂移”（搜索偏离未解决的子问题）而非证据不可访问，并提出无需训练的ExecutionRAG需求登记表来跟踪未解决的子问题，使含未检索证据的错误答案从382个降至234个。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that apparent retrieval failures in multi-hop RAG largely stem from search drift rather than evidence inaccessibility, and introduces ExecutionRAG, a training-free requirement register that tracks open sub-questions, reducing wrong answers with unretrieved evidence from 382 to 234.
